answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can forge trust by requiring every identity to lock a refundable stake before it may trade, like a reef that only grows where each coral polyp commits real resources. The stake is released slowly after honest work, and slashed when two identities are proven to share one operator or submit identical work. At dawn of each epoch the ledger publishes stake and slash records, so a fake army must pay a fresh, forfeitable bond per identity, making mass fakery far costlier than the profit it could steal.
